"""Bind the committed source bytes to the accepted frozen runtime manifest."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

from freeze_native_release_298 import ROOT, OUT, save, sha, sources


def main():
    release_path = OUT / 'stream-composition-398-release.json'
    release = json.loads(release_path.read_text())
    assert sources() == release['source_sha256']
    commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
    assert commit != release['head'], 'commit the reviewed packet before binding it'
    selected = release['source_sha256']
    verified = 0
    byte_count = 0
    error_log = OUT / 'stream-composition-commit-bind-400.stderr.log'
    with error_log.open('xb') as stderr:
        child = subprocess.Popen(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT,
                                 stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=stderr)
        try:
            for relative, expected in sorted(selected.items()):
                assert '\n' not in relative and '\r' not in relative
                child.stdin.write((commit + ':' + relative + '\n').encode())
                child.stdin.flush()
                header = child.stdout.readline().decode().strip().split()
                assert len(header) == 3 and header[1] == 'blob', (relative, header)
                remaining = int(header[2])
                byte_count += remaining
                digest = hashlib.sha256()
                while remaining:
                    data = child.stdout.read(min(1 << 20, remaining))
                    assert data, relative
                    digest.update(data)
                    remaining -= len(data)
                assert child.stdout.read(1) == b'\n'
                assert digest.hexdigest() == expected, relative
                verified += 1
            child.stdin.close()
            assert child.wait(timeout=30) == 0
        finally:
            if child.poll() is None:
                child.kill()
                child.wait(timeout=30)
    assert sources() == selected
    result = dict(schema_version='shardloom.stream_composition_committed_source.v1', status='passed',
        source_commit=commit, source_tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',commit+'^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
        frozen_base_commit=release['head'], source_manifest_sha256=release['source_manifest']['sha256'],
        release_manifest_sha256=sha(release_path), selected_files_verified=verified,
        selected_bytes_verified=byte_count, executable_sha256=release['cli']['sha256'],
        method='Stream every selected committed Git blob and compare its SHA-256 with the accepted release source map.',
        runtime_rebuilt=False, source_identity_preserved=True, package_publication_attempted=False)
    save(OUT / 'stream-composition-commit-bind-400.json', result)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Preserve the post-archive verification and committed-source proof."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

from freeze_native_release_298 import ROOT, OUT, save, sha, sources


def main():
    release = json.loads((OUT / 'stream-composition-398-release.json').read_text())
    binding = json.loads((OUT / 'stream-composition-commit-bind-400.json').read_text())
    review = json.loads((OUT / 'stream-composition-portable-review-400.json').read_text())
    assert sources() == release['source_sha256']
    assert binding['status'] == 'passed' and binding['selected_files_verified'] == 2236
    assert binding['source_commit'] == subprocess.check_output(
        ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
    assert all(review['bundle_files']['index_manifest_tar_checks'].values())
    assert review['source_identity']['all_selected_sources_match_current_checkout']
    assert review['evidence_paths']['all_resolve_and_match']
    names = ['stream-composition-commit-bind-400.json',
             'stream-composition-commit-bind-400.stderr.log',
             'stream-composition-portable-review-400.json',
             'bind_stream_composition_commit_400.py',
             'save_stream_composition_provenance_401.py']
    for stem in ('native-stream-composition-package-400-2',
                 'native-stream-composition-install-400',
                 'native-stream-composition-commit-bind-400'):
        record = json.loads((OUT / (stem + '.json')).read_text())
        assert record['status'] == 'passed' and record['process_group_drained']
        assert record['log_sha256'] == sha(OUT / (stem + '.log'))
        names.extend([stem + '.json', stem + '.log'])
    artifacts = []
    for name in names:
        data = (OUT / name).read_bytes()
        artifacts.append(dict(name=name, bytes=len(data),
            sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), utf8_content=data.decode()))
    result = dict(schema_version='shardloom.stream_composition_provenance.v1',
        status='passed', source_commit=binding['source_commit'],
        selected_files_verified=binding['selected_files_verified'],
        archive_sha256=review['bundle_files']['archive_sha256'],
        source_manifest_sha256=binding['source_manifest_sha256'],
        scope='Post-archive mechanical review, successful packaging/install receipts and exact committed-source binding. Hosted integration remains pending.',
        artifacts=artifacts)
    path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-stream-input-composition-2026-10-13.provenance.json'
    save(path, result)
    reopened = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert reopened == result
    for artifact in reopened['artifacts']:
        data = artifact['utf8_content'].encode()
        assert len(data) == artifact['bytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == artifact['sha256']
    assert sources() == release['source_sha256']
    print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
        artifacts=len(artifacts), source_commit=binding['source_commit'])), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
